comments.author: Quinn
comments.html: what was your inspiration for the artifact and it’s design? (Specifically the orb atop the scepter)

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Excellent question Quinn. My inspiration for the golden orb crown piece of the Incan Sun Staff was Pierre de Fobis (ca. 1507-ca. 1580) Clockwork armillary sphere, Lyons, 1540-1550
Paris, Collection Kugel. (Note the timeframe is contemporary with Pizarro’s Incan expedition.) Here’s a link:

http://brunelleschi.imss.fi.it/galileopalazzostrozzi/object/PierreDeFobisClockworkArmillarySpher.html
